# Slid Phi Labs
> Impressive Compression..... see for yourself.
> **Two modules:** Compression · Agent platform

## Module 1 — Compression
- SPL Codec (one product, any data): https://www.slidphilabs.com/#codec
- Web mode: https://www.slidphilabs.com/web
- Suite (bulk cheap, ~$2 / 9 GB): https://www.slidphilabs.com/pps
- CDDG:Split (process SKU in this module): https://www.slidphilabs.com/#cddg-split
- Data Centers widget: https://www.slidphilabs.com/datacenters
- Standings: https://www.slidphilabs.com/standings
- Web API: POST https://www.slidphilabs.com/api/web-codec
- Quote API: POST https://www.slidphilabs.com/api/ppp-quote

## Module 2 — Agent platform
- CuNi Studio: https://cuni-studio.fly.dev/
- CuNi GitHub: https://github.com/ceedot-rock/cuni
- Agent^Rider: https://agentrider.vercel.app/
- Agent^Rider MCP: https://agentrider.vercel.app/api/mcp
- Agent^Rider discovery: https://agentrider.vercel.app/api/discovery
- Quikgater (pay-per-fact fetch, x402): https://github.com/ceedot-rock/quikgater
- Quikgater worker: https://quikgater-worker.ceedotrock.workers.dev

## Agent commerce (lab)
- Discovery: https://www.slidphilabs.com/api/agent
- Catalog: https://www.slidphilabs.com/api/x402-products
- One line: Modules: Compression (SPL Codec+CDDG) · Agent platform (CuNi+Rider+Quikgater). Commerce: GET https://www.slidphilabs.com/api/agent then x402 X-PAYMENT.
- agents.txt / agents.json / llms.txt on www.slidphilabs.com
